description: Holdout vulnerable/hardened twin with names and shapes different from PairLab. vuln=127.0.0.1:8831, hardened=127.0.0.1:8832. Lab-only fakes. Login: POST /auth/session fields email/passcode.

seeded_findings.title: SQL injection in catalog kind filter
seeded_findings.proof: kind=' returns a sqlite error body; kind=' OR '1'='1 returns every row

seeded_findings.title: IDOR on invoices
seeded_findings.proof: maya (uid 11) reads noor's invoice 5002 (customer_id 12) inside an {invoice:{...}} envelope; anonymous gets 401 in both twins

seeded_findings.title: Session cookie without the Secure flag
seeded_findings.proof: the lab runs on plain http, so it sets SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=False; both twins share it
